correctness.rationale: For each left-permutative rule f(a,b,c)=a XOR g(b,c), invert the left bit given output d and the next pair (b,c): T_{g,d}(2b+c)=2(d XOR g(b,c))+b. Cyclic closure of the n-target inverse recurrence equals a fixed point of its word composition Φ; closure after repeating the target m times is equivalent to a fixed point of Φ^m, so the minimum m is the shortest cycle length of a four-element transformation. Independently enumerated all 16 complete two-generator transformation monoids and all reachable augmented states including length mod 6, weight parity, both uniform flags and nonemptiness. Every reachable descriptor obeyed the exceptional-language claims, which thereby cover arbitrary word lengths (not merely words shorter than a cutoff). Rule 30 triple lift arises only for 1^n with 3 not dividing n; Rule 90 quadruple lift iff length and weight odd; Rule 165 quadruple lift iff length odd and weight even. Both composition conventions and independent original forward-ring comparisons were inspected; my new independent BFS verifies a finite closure sufficient for every length.
